findings.initialGap: Pre-begin exclusive no-follow creation/device-inode check alone did not specify post-write stable descriptor/path identity, length and immutable packet capture. A host sidecar hash of a changed path would not establish original writer custody.
findings.requiredResolution: Explicit stable final descriptor/path and length/hash capture checks, invalidity on mutation/drift, sealed retained stream, and no adversarial-authentication claim.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending

findings.initialGap: The draft promised a separate close result without choosing a mechanism; Rust std::fs::File Drop exposes no close Result.
findings.requiredResolution: Remove the unobservable std File Drop close-result claim or choose and inventory an explicit mechanism. Keep write/sync/flush/close/durability outcomes distinct.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending

findings.initialGap: A flag stored only in a RefCell writer cannot be mutated when try_borrow fails; wrong-thread TLS can appear inactive.
findings.requiredResolution: Independently writable run-validity latch and owner coordinate, included in complete observer inventory and finite fault controls.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending
findings.topic: Sticky invalidity under reentrancy and wrong thread

findings.initialGap: The partial replay requires an active pin for Failure. Observer overhead can shift the actual result to construction, execution, WASI or deadline failure outside a pin.
findings.requiredResolution: Full closed protocol must support terminal original failure outside active pin with independently bound cursor/absent identity; partial model limitation remains explicit.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending
findings.topic: Terminal failure without an active pin operation

findings.initialGap: End read the shared invalidity latch into the footer before deactivating. A concurrent wrong-thread callback could latch invalidity after the snapshot while active remained true.
findings.requiredResolution: Require a bounded finalization/quiescence handshake or independently established no-concurrent-callback dispatch, with a fail-closed external custody/status observation that cannot lose late invalidity. Include every new atomic/guard/temporary in the complete logical inventory.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending

findings.initialGap: Stable immutable capture introduces a second full stream file; the per-file maximum did not state the two-file transient/retained contribution.
findings.requiredResolution: State one copy attempt, no copy retry, at most 1,073,743,872 bytes across two stream files plus 8,192 sidecar bytes, before separately bounded original output/result transport. Inventory host copy buffers and descriptors separately from the 16 KiB live-writer ceiling.
findings.resolution: written contract corrected; actual Rust/driver implementation evidence remains pending

findings.initialGap: The finite decoder accepted cap-only flags when stored was below the header cap; encode always produced consistent cap cases, so existing tests did not expose it. Independent attempt-1 fixture accidentally exercised this admission.
findings.requiredResolution: For cap-only strict prefix require stored==declared cap and attempted>stored; include a mutated-header cap control. Correct independent tiny-cap fixtures and preserve the initial source/input evidence.
findings.resolution: corrected finite cap decoder and independent fixture; full schema remains pending
